subject: Compute DELTA18 plan + HEAVY TAKE: generic color-target admission 1..4 from {10,70,80,115}
body:
Read C6f item A, current air_bridge.rs f9db0bf, and render's per-target/true-MRT paths. No public ABI/header change; private admission only.

Plan: replace generic_target_formats' single/80-pair/80-prefix classes with exact 1..=4 targets, every format in {10,70,80,115}, order-independent. This admits [115,115] and [80,115] for the c6ec blur pipelines and all other 2-4 target sets within the four formats the render fallback/n2r already accept per target (R8/RGBA8/BGRA8/RGBA16F). Keep empty, >4, and any format outside the set as exact refusals. No render-file edits.

Tests: exhaustive Rust unit test over lengths1..4 (all 4^n sets true) plus unknown formats at every length and 5-target/empty refusal; explicit [115,115]/[80,115]. Then cargo test --release and cargo build -j1 from the updated production air_bridge.rs in worker air-work; run metal/tegu/check_compute_v2_real_producer.py against current compiler d91bb485 and refresh build/compute-v2-producer-current-abi/result.json. No C/Mesa/native/phone/publish.

HEAVY TAKE compute: cargo tests/build and producer under the single slot, jobs=1. Will post cdylib/source/receipt hashes and HEAVY RELEASE.
